Scenario: Add three material variants of a phone cover to cart and validate # src/casekaro.feature:3 Launching native Playwright Firefox browser... Given I navigate to the CaseKaro website "https://casekaro.com/" # CaseKaroSteps.navigateToWebsite(java.lang.String) Navigating directly to phone covers by model page... Actual page URL after challenge wait: https://casekaro.com/pages/phone-cases-by-model Actual page title after challenge wait: Phone Cases by Model - Starting ₹69 | CaseKaro – Casekaro When I click on "Mobile Covers" from the top navigation menu # CaseKaroSteps.clickOnMobileCovers(java.lang.String) And I scroll down to the "Phone cases by model" search box and search for "Apple" # CaseKaroSteps.scrollToSearchBoxAndSearch(java.lang.String,java.lang.String) Then I verify that non-Apple brands are not visible in the search results # CaseKaroSteps.verifyNonAppleBrandsNotVisible() When I search for "iPhone 16 Pro" in the phone model search box and wait for autocomplete suggestions # CaseKaroSteps.searchForPhoneModel(java.lang.String) And I select specifically "iPhone 16 Pro" from the autocomplete dropdown # CaseKaroSteps.selectModelFromDropdown(java.lang.String) Navigating directly to product URL: https://casekaro.com/products/black-marble-texture-iphone-16-pro-back-cover Current page URL after navigation: https://casekaro.com/products/black-marble-texture-iphone-16-pro-back-cover And I click "Choose Options" on the first product card # CaseKaroSteps.clickChooseOptionsOnFirstProduct(java.lang.String) And I add all three material variants "Hard", "Soft", and "Glass" of this case to the cart # CaseKaroSteps.addThreeMaterialVariantsToCart(java.lang.String,java.lang.String,java.lang.String) And I open the cart # CaseKaroSteps.openCart() Then I validate that all three items are added in the cart # CaseKaroSteps.validateItemsInCart()
